name: agent-setup-window
title: Agent setup window
description: Tabbed agent setup instructions for Prompt, MCP, and CLI, with copy actions and an animated prompt preview.
usage: Showing how to connect an agent next to a section heading. Wrap it in the ring (`rounded-card bg-ring-tint p-2`) on white.
avoid: Agent logos recolored to the brand blue
Toasts from the component itself (pass onCopy)
notes:
The methods are the site's brand pill tabs turned for the dark bar: a faint white track, the labels in white at 60%, and a
white outline gliding to the picked one on the tabs' spring (it jumps with reduced motion).

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
